title: Volunteer | The Salvation Army
location: Tucson, AZ 85705 (Tucson Amphi Corps, Hospitality House, All Nations)
hours_note: At least one shift per week (Monday-Friday, only) for the 3-month duration; shifts 2-3 hours
description: Serve unhoused/low-income people, assist kitchen staff, help at intake desk, disaster relief. Help neighbors without access to adequate cooling.
requirements: Age 18+, commit to at least one shift per week (Mon-Fri) for 3 months, background check, orient, contact Kristin Ohman

title: Food Pantry Volunteer
hours_note: 7 days/week, 8:30 am to 11:30 am (3 hours per day)
schedule_flexibility: Every day except Thanksgiving and Christmas
description: Welcome guests, sort donations, pack food boxes for clients, help open/clean food pantry. Part of Catholic Workers feeding the homeless.
requirements: Virtual volunteer orientation, ability to welcome guests and sort donations, no experience required

title: Youth On Their Own (YOTO) Mini Mall Volunteer
location: 2525 N Country Club Rd, Tucson, AZ 85716
hours_note: Access the Mini Mall once per week for basic needs items (food, toiletries, school supplies, household items)
description: Support high school graduation and continued success of homeless/youth experiencing poverty. Provide guidance, financial assistance, basic human needs, and support at the YOTO office.
requirements: No prior experience required; sign up via yoto.org portal

title: Online Volunteer Tutor
hours_note: Minimum 1 hour a week for 1 year
description: One-on-one online tutoring for students via Be A Mentor virtual platform. Help youth build confidence, set goals, and work toward big goals.
requirements: Background check, attend orientation, 21+ years old, minimum one hour a week for a full year

title: Transcription Volunteer
hours_note: Edit 2 documents per week; 3 or more hours each week
schedule_flexibility: Weekdays daytime, evenings, weekends daytime, evenings
description: Transcribe key messages for professional documentation (APS format, biblical scriptures). Remote, anywhere in world.
requirements: Native English speaker, copy editing/document editor skills, knowledge of religious terminology, experience in content editing or transcription
